assets.caption: A chromosome is not the same count as a chromatid
assets.description: G1 has four chromosomes and four DNA molecules. G2 after replication has four chromosomes, eight chromatids and eight DNA molecules. Mitotic metaphase has the same count. assets.caption: How four duplicated chromosomes become two equal nuclei
assets.description: The same diploid set of four duplicated chromosomes appears condensed in prophase, then aligned at metaphase. Telophase shows two re-forming nuclei, each with four single-chromatid chromosomes. Illustrative chromosomes and distances are not to scale and this is not a micrograph.

assets.caption: Electron donation by reduced NAD and proton pumping
assets.description: In the mitochondrial matrix, reduced NAD from glycolysis, the link reaction and Krebs cycle gives an electron pair to the first electron carrier of the inner-membrane chain, becoming NAD plus.
